texts.f006: They're whistling sounds.
texts.f009: I've been more jumpy than usual.
texts.f010: I've been sleeping less.
texts.f011: I keep going over things in my head and can't stop.
texts.f015: My wife and I separated four months ago.
texts.f017: One week before the tics started I went into my daughter's room, the first time since the separation.
texts.f019: A former coworker of mine has Tourette's syndrome.
